events.label: PepsiCo (PEP) Q2 2026 earnings (pre-market) — Q2 earnings season kickoff; consumer demand barometer
events.note: First significant Q2 2026 earnings report. Beat + raised guidance = consumer demand held despite 57K NFP growth scare; supports the soft-landing narrative and BUY regime. Miss or lowered guidance = growth-scare confirms; risk-off pressure heading into CPI July 14. Sets the tone for consumer-staples read heading into Q2 earnings season peak (META, GOOGL, MSFT, AMZN all reporting late July).

events.label: SKHY ADR pricing (after US close) — SK Hynix $28B Nasdaq offering; reference price ~$158/ADS
events.note: SKHY ADR prices after the US close on July 9. Reference price: ~$158/ADS. >$165/ADS = institutional HBM4 demand confirmed despite KOSPI circuit-breaker; re-entry activated at July 10 open. $158-$165 = fair demand, enter 50%. <$158 = demand miss; KOSPI circuit-breaker narrative extends to ADR. FOMC hawkishness (Sep hike 68.8%) is the primary swing risk to pricing environment. ~$7B in cornerstone investor commitments.

events.label: SKHY Nasdaq ADR debut (largest foreign IPO in history); Delta Air Lines (DAL) Q2 earnings
events.note: Two sector clearing events: (1) SKHY debut — opening print vs. IPO price is the HBM4 demand thesis clearing event. >$175 opening = strong demand, full-size entry activated. $165-$175 = fair demand, enter 50%. <$165 = demand miss; KOSPI circuit-breaker narrative extends to ADR; wait. (2) DAL Q2 tests whether 57K NFP growth scare is filtering into travel demand — strong bookings support consumer resilience. MSCI World inclusion timeline for SKHY begins at listing.

events.label: June CPI release (8:30 AM ET) — regime-defining; May baseline 4.2%; FOMC Sep hike at 68.8% probability
events.note: June CPI is the summer's regime-defining event. Context: FOMC minutes July 8 confirmed no cuts until Q2 2027, September hike probability 68.8%. Brent crude averaged ~$72+ in June's final weeks (up from $66-70 prior estimate — Iran conflict elevated); ISM Prices Paid dropped to 73.0 from 82.1. Scenario A: CPI ≤3.5% → September hike probability collapses; BUY upgrades to HIGH conviction; full earnings season adds activated. Scenario B: CPI ≥4.0% → stagflation confirmed; STEP ASIDE/BEARISH warranted. Scenario C: 3.5-4.0% → maintain MEDIUM HOLD into July 28 FOMC. CPI is the ultimate regime arbiter for Q3 2026.

events.label: TSLA Q2 2026 earnings (est.) — after market close; 480K delivery beat sets the floor
events.note: Q2 earnings follow the July 2 delivery report: 480,126 vehicles delivered (vs. 406,024 consensus; +25% YoY; best-ever Q2). Despite the blowout beat, TSLA fell ~7.49% on July 2 (sell-the-news + growth scare). Q2 earnings call (~July 22) is the fundamental clearing event: need gross margin recovery (>25%), FSD revenue recognition at scale, and Q3 delivery guide >450K for the stock to re-rate above $420. Weak gross margin (<22%) or no FSD clarity = $393 July 2 close is the near-term top.

events.label: FOMC meeting (July 28-29) — July hike probability ~20%; September hike 68.8%; June CPI (~Jul 14) is the determining input
events.note: July 28 FOMC hike probability ~19-20% (no change expected at July meeting). June 17 FOMC minutes (released July 8) confirmed: no cuts until Q2 2027; September hike probability 68.8%; December 85.3%. The June CPI release (July 14) is the primary input — CPI ≤3.5% would collapse September hike probability; CPI ≥4.0% would confirm September hike as base case. SCOTUS upheld Fed independence June 29 — Warsh can move in either direction without political pressure.

events.label: META Q2 2026 earnings — AI cloud business first quantification; earnings season peak week
events.note: META Q2 earnings July 29 is the first event where management must quantify the cloud business (Bloomberg July 1: Meta building AI cloud to sell excess compute). META +2.98% on July 6 on rate-relief bid. Q2 earnings is the first AI-at-scale quarter. GOOGL, MSFT, and AMZN also report in mid-to-late July — peak Q2 earnings risk window. ISM Services 54.0% (July 6) validates the Search and Cloud AI expansion narrative.

events.label: Iran-US ceasefire 60-day deadline (original Islamabad Declaration) — now voided; Iran conflict ongoing
events.note: The original Islamabad MOU signed June 18 set a 60-day window expiring August 13. That framework has been declared 'over' by Trump on July 8 after Iran-IRGC struck US military targets in Bahrain/Kuwait. US conducted 80+ counterstrikes. Brent at $78.02 on July 8 close (+5.2%). Watch for back-channel diplomatic reopening — Trump's July 8 statement included 'talks can continue.' Any ceasefire restoration would sharply reverse energy sector and re-open the dual-gate buffer.

events.label: NVDA Q2 FY27 earnings (est.) — $91B revenue guide; AI capex cycle fundamental clearing event
events.note: NVDA's Q2 FY27 earnings is the fundamental clearing event for the AI capex thesis. $91B revenue guidance represents sequential acceleration. NVDA ~$203 on July 8 (Gate 3 confirmed on China H200 approval). China's H200 approval (<200K chips, training-only) extends NVDA's training moat; inference displacement risk from DeepSeek remains. Half-size hold maintained through August 26. Full-size add gate: NVDA close above $200 + SPX >7,460 + VIX <17 + CPI ≤3.5% (July 14). August 26 earnings remains the ultimate fundamental clearing event.

events.label: SPCX first earnings as a public company (approx.) — Starlink ARR + Starship cadence
events.note: First earnings print since June 12 IPO. SPCX Nasdaq-100 effective July 7; inclusion-day distribution confirmed at $158.77 peak. Re-entry gate: two consecutive closes above $185 on above-average volume. First earnings (Starlink subscriber/ARR growth, Starship launch cadence, cash burn) is the fundamental clearing event after the inclusion-day distribution pattern. Lock-up expiry December 9 adds supply overhang.

events.label: SPCX 180-day IPO lock-up expiry (approx.) — insider/early-investor float unlock
events.note: ~180 days after the June 12 debut, early investors and insiders can sell, materially expanding the ~4% public float. Lock-up expiries are a known supply overhang for hot IPOs. The $20B bond offering (June 22) already changed the capital structure risk profile — the lock-up expiry adds equity supply overhang.

events.label: OpenAI IPO — target window shifts to H1 2027 after 2026 delay
events.note: OpenAI delayed its anticipated 2026 IPO to H1 2027 (announced June 26, 2026). SoftBank sold off -13% on the delay. Microsoft and NVIDIA hold strategic stakes. The delay removes a near-term AI sentiment catalyst and adds uncertainty to AI infrastructure spending trajectories.
